title: Credit cards
subtitle: What is on each card, and when the bank is charged for it.
emptyBody: Add a card with its billing day, and purchases on it count on the day the bank is charged.
expired: This card has expired. Add the new one, or update its expiry.
expiresSoon: This card expires soon: the new one should be on its way.
noBillingDay: No billing day yet. Set one, and this card's purchases will count on the day the bank is charged.
limitLeft: <left></left> left to use. Instalments count in full until they are paid.

commitments.title: Total commitments on the card
commitments.householdBody: Everything the household's cards will still charge the bank: purchases waiting for their bill, and every payment still to come on instalments, credit and loans.
commitments.interestHint: As the card charges them, interest included.
commitments.planLeft: {{left}} of {{count}} payments left, the last on {{date}}

edit.expiresHint: As printed on the card, month and year.
edit.expiresInvalid: Use the month and year on the card, like 09/28.
edit.billingDayHint: The day the bank pays the card each month. A month's purchases are charged together on this day of the next month.
edit.billingDayInvalid: A day of the month, 1 to 31.
edit.fxFeeHint: Added to every purchase in a currency other than the shekel.
edit.creditRateHint: Filled in for you on a credit plan charged to this card.
edit.lateRateHint: Charged if a bill is not paid on time.
edit.rateInvalid: Enter a rate, like 1.5 (or -0.5 below prime).
edit.monthlyFeeHint: Leave empty if the card has no fee. Charged on the card each month from now on.
edit.discountHint: 100% waives the fee. Usually for a year from when the card was issued; leave Until empty if it has no end.
edit.debitedFromHint: The account the card's monthly bill is taken from.
edit.lastDigitsHint: As the card company shows them. Only these four are kept: never the rest of the number.
edit.lastDigitsInvalid: The last four digits of the card.

discountEarned: Spent <spent></spent> of <target></target>: <percent></percent> off the fee this month.
discountToGo: Spent <spent></spent> of <target></target> for <percent></percent> off the fee.
discountNoEnd: The discount has no end date.

accounts.title: Bank accounts
accounts.body: The accounts the household's cards are paid from, and how far below zero each can go.
accounts.empty: No bank accounts yet. Add one, and each card can say which account pays its bill.
accounts.branchMerged: This branch closed on {{date}}; its accounts moved to branch {{into}}.
accounts.cardsFrom: Card bills paid from this account

edit.bankEmpty: No bank by that name or code.
edit.groupMerged: Older codes, of banks that merged
edit.branchUnknown: There is no branch {{branch}} at {{bank}} in the Bank of Israel's list. Check the number.
edit.branchUnlisted: The Bank of Israel's list has no branch names for this bank.
edit.numberHint: Pasting the whole account, like 12-689-123456, fills in the bank and branch too. Only the number is kept: never a password or code.
edit.holdersHint: Everyone in the household who is on the account.
edit.holdersInvalid: Choose who the account belongs to.
edit.overdraftHint: How far below zero the bank lets the account go. Leave empty if it has none.

other.title: Other ways to pay
other.body: Debit cards, wallets, transfers and standing orders. Cash and cheques are built in, for everyone.
other.builtin: Built in: always there, for everyone

unfinished.accounts_one: 1 bank account from Add with AI is still to finish.
